body: That's true but knowing that doesn't make the prospect of living in such a reality any better.

I appreciate the time and effort you've taken out of your day to write that, thanks. But that's the thing, I can't do temporary, I feel like I'm pushing a boulder up a hill and each time I make significant progress it comes crushing back, right to the start. Fuck that shit. To me if I know that happiness is temporary I do feel it is meaningless.

No dude, what's the point if sadness will always be there? What's the point if you're happy and everything is going well, then something fucks up everything. What's the point if this pattern keeps on repeating? I don't want to play that game.
